properties.name: reflow2's site (flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2) carries a guide to making a hub, or project brain: a design over several designs, locally with reflow2 alone and on flo2.io, with the hub skill's rules and what a hub holds
properties.statement: The site SHALL carry a page, beside the explainer and the setup page and in their layout, that explains the hub, or project brain, in a person's words: a design that stands over several designs and holds what spans them — who is in the effort, how it works, the decisions about process, the links between members — while each member design stays its own; how to make one with reflow2 alone (genesis a design, record each member with external_dependency and its relation — part of this or a peer it uses — and work it with the hub skill: one search over the tracked designs, a change's impact carried member to member, a requirement handed to the design that owns it); how to make one on flo2.io (make a hub from chat, give it a design — new or one you already have — share it once, and everyone in it reads every member); the two-tier pattern for a system of systems (the hub for the effort, a system-of-systems design for what no part owns, and the rule for which finding goes where); and what is coming (the cross-design operations by graph_id and the on-demand view, named as intent, not as shipped). It states the version it was checked against like the other pages and is checked by tools/check_doc_versions.py. Asked for by Anthony 2026-10-11.
